# 7.css

Vendored copy of **7.css v0.21.1** (MIT), sourced from
<https://unpkg.com/7.css@0.21.1> / <https://github.com/khang-nd/7.css>.

The dashboard loads 7.css from the pinned CDN and falls back to this local copy
when the CDN is unavailable. Custom Aero Glass styling lives in `../css/aero.css`.
